info.title: DigiRakt API
info.description: Blood bank management and emergency blood coordination. Every response uses the envelope `{ success, data, meta? }` or `{ success: false, message, errorCode, details?, requestId? }`. Response `data` types are the interfaces exported by `@bbms/shared`. This document is generated from the route table (`npm run docs:openapi -w @bbms/backend`).
